title: per-tenant-penalty-decayer-and-eviction-grace-timer
author: Maya Hernandez
release_notes: Hotfix: Add decaying per-tenant penalty credits and eviction grace timer to prevent permanent tenant penalization and reduce flapping during regional capacity pressure. Improves SLO enforcement stability and reduces false-positive evictions.
description: Context: After incident INC-2026-02-09 we observed tenants getting long-lived penalty scores from the SLO enforcer that prevented automatic recovery even after load normalized which caused unnecessary evictions and customer impact. This PR introduces a decaying-credit mechanism per tenant plus a configurable eviction grace timer so that penalties naturally decay and eviction decisions use a bounded hold window to avoid flip-flopping. Goals: 1) allow tenants to recover automatically without manual intervention, 2) reduce eviction churn during short regional pressure spikes, 3) keep SLO enforcement deterministic and auditable. Implementation summary: - Add TenantPenaltyStore with time-decay semantics and jittered decrement schedules integrated into the slo-enforcer loop. - Introduce eviction_grace_ms in the node-allocator and per-tenant hold state so that once a tenant is marked for probation it cannot be evicted for the duration of the grace window unless explicit hard-fail conditions are met. - Expose new runtime flags: --tenant-penalty-decay-ms and --eviction-grace-ms with sane defaults and feature flags gated behind experiments/penalty-decayer. - Add metrics: tenant_penalty_score{tenant,region}, tenant_penalty_decay_events_total, eviction_grace_trigger_total and dashboards for tracing penalty lifecycle. - Add unit tests for decay math, integration tests for end-to-end recovery scenarios and a small e2e load test that simulates a regional spike and recovery. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior (decay disabled) until ops flips the feature flag; config keys are optional and documented. Rollout plan: 1) deploy to canary cluster with feature flag off, 2) enable decay in canary with conservative decay rate, 3) monitor tenant_penalty_score and eviction events for 24-48h, 4) progressively enable for low-traffic regions, 5) full rollout if metrics stable. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-9042), [x] unit tests added, [x] integration test added, [x] metrics and dashboards updated, [x] docs updated in /docs/slo-enforcer/penalty-decay.md, [x] feature-flag gating implemented.
